P.name: Doom 'n Gloom
P.description:
{{sbc|Passive - Doom:}} Periodically, '''Vex''' empowers her next {{tip|ability|basic ability}} to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and {{tip|fear}} enemies hit for {{pp|0.75 to 1.5 for 4|1;6;9;13}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{pp|type=distance from '''Vex'''|60 to 99 for 11|250 to 800|key=%|formula=60% + 3.9% for every 55 units away from Vex}}. If ''{{ai|Looming Darkness 2|Vex|Looming Darkness}}'' triggers ''Doom'', enemies hit will {{tip|flee}} from the epicenter instead.
''Doom's'' {{sti|cooldown}} resets upon [[death|respawning]].
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Gloom:}} Nearby enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} that {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} will be marked with ''Gloom'' for 6 seconds. '''Vex's''' next {{tip|basic attack}}, which becomes {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, or basic ability hit against an enemy with ''Gloom'' will detonate the mark. ''{{ai|Looming Darkness|Vex}}'' will also inflict ''Gloom'', but cannot detonate it.
P.description3: ''Gloom's'' detonation deals {{pp|40 + (150-40)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and refunds 25% of ''Doom's'' cooldown. Against non-champions, this instead deals {{pp|40 to 60 for 5|1;6;9;13;16|key=%}} damage and refunds 10% of ''Doom's'' cooldown.

Q.name: Mistral Bolt
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' launches a wave of mist in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. After travelling 500 units, the wave accelerates but also narrows itself.

W.name: Personal Space
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' emits a deafening scream around her before the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

The scream's radius is slightly increased against enemies that are {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
W.description2: '''''Vex''' can move during Personal Space's cast time.''

E.name: Looming Darkness
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' tosses her ''Shadow'' to explode at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The explosion's radius increases based on cast distance.
E.description2: Killing an enemy with ''Looming Darkness'' refunds 10% of ''{{ai|Doom 'n Gloom|Vex|Doom's}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}, increased to 25% for champion kills.

R.name: Shadow Surge
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' sends her ''Shadow'' in the target direction, which grants {{tip|sight}} around its {{tt|trajectory|Does not see into brush or across terrain}} and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
R.description2: ''Shadow'' stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} to mark them for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. ''Shadow Surge'' can be recast while the target is marked.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vex''' {{tip|dashes}} towards the marked target with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she consumes their mark and deals {{as|magic damage}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|75+150 to 175+350}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20+50}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4: If '''Vex''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against ''Shadow Surge's'' marked target within 8 seconds of its application, '''Vex''' can cast ''Shadow Surge'' again within 12 seconds at no cost after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, repeating the effects.
